name: pdf2sch
description: Import a PDF schematic and generate a KiCad 9 schematic
description_full: pdf2sch detects components, wires, and text from a PDF schematic, builds a structured component/netlist model with a human-in-the-loop review step for low-confidence nets, and writes a valid KiCad 9 .kicad_sch file. It can also import PDF pages as rasterised background images so you can trace over them inside the schematic editor.
